title: Goldreich–Levin query complexity bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $0<\tau\le 1$, and let $k\le n$. Every outcome in the support of the run through stage $k$, including its recorded learning costs, uses at most $k\cdot 2\,\mathrm{cap}(\tau)\cdot 2m$ membership queries, where $\mathrm{cap}(\tau)=\left\lceil4/\tau^2\right\rceil$ and $m$ is the estimator sample count at accuracy $\tau^2/4$ and confidence parameter $\gamma=1/[40(n+1)(\mathrm{cap}(\tau)+1)]$.
hypotheses_covered: target Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
stage index $k$ is a natural number
outcome belongs to the support of the run with recorded costs
